Design study for gameplay · not a construction or life-safety plan

A working drawing, ready to change

Click a room to select it. Drag its interior to move it; drag the orange corner to resize. Use the inspector for exact metric dimensions and names.

Doors connect two rooms along their shared wall. When rooms move apart, the door is flagged and hidden, rather than left floating. Fix the adjacency or reconnect the door.

Aligned stairs and freight shafts are locked in the starting plan. Stair treads are symbolic; the footprints are gameplay placeholders, not engineered flights. Corridors are editable rooms too. Plan checks flag overlaps, detached doors and rooms without a route to a floor entrance.

Undo / redo: Ctrl or ⌘ Z / Shift Z. Arrow keys move a selected room 0.5 m. SVG export produces editable vector linework for Figma; JSON preserves the complete editable model.

Warm wood in lived-in spaces, pale concrete circulation, blue-grey technical rooms. The building steps around its circulation spine; blank space outside the outline is exterior or unexcavated rock.
